title: Broadcom Q3 Earnings Preview: I See Continued Margin Contraction (NASDAQ:AVGO) | Seeking Alpha
snippet:
Broadcom Inc. is expected to report robust FQ3 2026 top-line and EPS growth, but consensus margin expectations appear overly optimistic.
 I foresee continued margin pressure for AVGO, driven by shifting customer mix and intensifying competition in both the near and longer term.
 For the next 5 years, EPS growth is projected to lag sales growth (25.3% CAGR vs. 26.4%, respectively), leading to a net margin decline from 53.4% to 51.2% by the fiscal year. [...] Broadcom headquarters in San Jose, California, United States
